description: Pool of realistic free-text traveler signals used to synthesize persona-distillation training data. Sampled 1-5 per profile by scripts/gen-persona-data.ts. Each signal carries `d` (the PersonaWeights dimension it most moves: price|quality|location|vibe|flexibility) and `p` (a direction WITHIN that dimension, such that a +1 and a -1 on the same dimension contradict each other: price +1 frugal / -1 spends freely; quality +1 demands comfort / -1 happy roughing it; location +1 wants central-prime / -1 remote or indifferent; vibe +1 lively-characterful / -1 quiet-functional; flexibility +1 spontaneous-open / -1 fixed-planned). ~30% of generated profiles deliberately pair one +1 with one -1 on the same dimension and are tagged conflict:true in the dataset metadata so the eval can slice them separately.
split: `train` feeds the train + valid splits; `test` is held back exclusively for the test split so the eval measures generalisation to unseen phrasings rather than memorisation. A separate hand-written pool lives in persona-signals-human.json and feeds only the test-human split.
